init: Initialize or adopt a project; configure docs, rules, skills, context, Git and CI.
初始化、接管、规范、技能管理、环境配置
requirements: Capture exact user requests, maintain functional requirements, clarify and trace changes.
原始需求、功能拆解、澄清、变更
design: Design and compare architecture, algorithms and execution flows; plan before implementation.
技术架构、技术方案、技术流程、方案确认
contract: Define interfaces and examples; build reviewed skeletons and test their integration.
接口、样例数据、代码骨架、骨架联调
dev: Implement approved work; debug, optimize and coordinate iterative development.
执行、开发、算法优化、前端、后端、修复
accept: Define acceptance, test, verify, baseline and prepare delivery.
验收、自动化测试、评测、基线、发布
audit: Read-only evidence-first inspection of bugs, consistency, quality and architecture.
审查、bug检查、文档一致性、安全、性能
simpler: Simplify code, docs and tests without changing approved behavior.
文档整理、代码整理、测试整理、复杂度治理
